_note: Gate 1 words (docs/specs/gate1-one-delve.md). Names, actions, intents, the fight and delve screens' labels and the barrow's rooms (D-232); slices add road cards and letters.

ui.pick.action: Tap a target to see the odds; tap it again to act.
ui.pick.raise: {target} is {band}. Tap again to raise them to {amount}.
ui.pick.pack: Pick an item from the pack.
ui.end.won.line: The foes lie still or have fled into the dark.
ui.end.routed.line: No one is left on their feet.
ui.save.unreadable: The saved fight could not be read; it was kept aside and a new fight began.
ui.save.older: This fight was saved under older rules; numbers may differ from now on.
ui.broken: Something went wrong with this fight. Its save is kept aside; you can start a new fight.
ui.start.title: A new delve
ui.start.sub: 5 or 6 rooms; the warden waits at the end
ui.start.ask: The party stands at the barrow's edge. How do they go in?
ui.start.note: Success at the barrow mouth catches the first fight's foes off guard: they lose round 1.
ui.room.offguard: Off guard: the foes lose round 1.
ui.room.alerted: Alerted: the foes act first in round 1.
ui.choice.fail.hurt: If it fails: the tester loses {n} health.
ui.choice.fail.alert: If it fails: the next room's foes are alerted.
ui.choice.ok.entry: {name} gets through. The first fight's foes are off guard.
ui.choice.failed.alert: {name} fails. The next room's foes are alerted.
ui.breather.out: {names} stays Down for the next room unless raised.
ui.scout.heard.line: A stone turns underfoot. Something in the dark ahead stops moving.
ui.scout.rules: Hounds bite the front row; archers shoot the back row's most hurt first.
ui.retreat.title: Retreat from the barrow?
ui.retreat.lead: {name} leads the way out (best Wits standing): {chance}%.
ui.retreat.beats.carry: {beats} beats carrying the fallen; {failed} if {name} fails.
ui.retreat.strike: Each beat the {n} standing foes strike once; the Down roll to bleed and the Dying roll for death.
ui.retreat.ends: The delve ends: retreated, or routed if no one stands at the end. Parts found so far are kept.
ui.end.delve.retreated.line: Out of the barrow, carrying the fallen.
ui.end.delve.routed.line: No one is left on their feet.

room.sample-fight.name: The hound run
room.sample-fight.line: Bones gnawed white along a low passage.

room.barrow-mouth.name: The barrow mouth
room.barrow-mouth.line: A stone door, half sunk in the turf, scored with grave marks.

room.hound-run.name: The hound run
room.hound-run.line: Bones gnawed white along a low passage. Hounds lift their heads; an archer stands behind them.

room.bone-niches.name: The bone niches
room.bone-niches.line: Skulls watch from the walls. Two hounds pace; two archers wait in the niches.

room.long-gallery.name: The long gallery
room.long-gallery.line: A narrow hall of pillars. A hound in front, archers far back in the dark.

room.kennel-pit.name: The kennel pit
room.kennel-pit.line: Chains and straw. A pack of hounds, and an archer on the rim above.

room.watchers-ledge.name: The watchers' ledge
room.watchers-ledge.line: Archers line a ledge over the passage; hounds guard the way up.

room.fallen-passage.name: The fallen passage
room.fallen-passage.line: The roof has come down. Rubble chokes the way.

room.sunken-floor.name: The sunken floor
room.sunken-floor.line: The floor has dropped away into black water.

room.sealed-door.name: The sealed grave door
room.sealed-door.line: A door bound in iron, cut with warding marks.

room.burial-hall.name: The burial hall
room.burial-hall.line: The warden rises from its bier, a hound and an archer at its side.
